alternatives_named: Leave hyperscaler_bar and industry-pattern fields as implied enforcement
Ship Connect social-expansion validators inside PR #130
Copy SAP SaaS detail into Connect PRDs
Leave MES benchmark coverage as prose-only competitive-gap text
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: Keep PR #130 as a bounded Connect PRD/design planning contract, preserve the seven-product Connect catalog, add honest advisory boundaries, keep SAP SaaS benchmarking where it belongs: Enterprise suite/masterplan competitor context, and add MES coverage as a separate Industrial/M07 planning artifact.
rejected_reasons: ADR-0126 conflicts with inherited Bominal ADR numbering and would make the decision record ambiguous.
Deleting the four new Connect child PRDs would avoid scope pressure but lose the accepted Connect expansion direction.
Implied enforcement is dishonest until validators and implementation crates exist.
Validator implementation would broaden PR #130 beyond a review repair and increase merge risk.
SAP SaaS is an Enterprise suite benchmark, not a Connect social-product benchmark.
Prose-only MES coverage does not support the user's competitor-awareness bar; a source-backed machine-readable artifact is needed before M07 planning deepens.
